markers.note: Proposition I diagram: two circles AEB, CED tangent at E, with parallel diameters AB, CD and centres O, G.
Proposition II diagram: semicircle CBA with tangents DC, DB and perpendicular BE.
Proposition III diagram: circle segment CA with point B, perpendicular BD, and points E, F.
Proposition IV diagram: the Arbelon figure (semicircle ABC with two smaller semicircles AD, DC on the diameter).
Proposition V diagram: semicircle AB with point C on the diameter, two semicircles AC, CB, and two tangent circles (points D,F,I,H,E,N,G,L,M).
Proposition VI diagram: semicircle ABC with point D (AD sesquialtera of DC), two semicircles on AD/DC, and inscribed circle EF (the 19:6 ratio construction).
Proposition VII diagram: circle circumscribing square AB with inscribed circle CD.
Proposition VIII diagram: circle with line AB produced to C, and points D, E, F, G (arc trisection construction). Same printed leaf/page as Proposition VII, which precedes it on the same page.
Proposition IX diagram: circle with two perpendicular chords AB, CD meeting off-centre, diameter EF, and points G, H.
Proposition X diagram: circle ABC with tangent DA, secant DB, tangent DC, and points E, F, G, H.
Proposition XI diagram: circle with two perpendicular chords AB, CD meeting at E (not the centre), points D, A, C, B, F.
Proposition XII diagram: semicircle on diameter AB with two tangents from external point C touching at D, E, meeting chords at F, and CG perpendicular to AB.
Proposition XIII diagram: circle with diameter AB, chord CD, perpendiculars AE, BF, and centre I with perpendicular IG.
Proposition XIV diagram: the Salinon figure (semicircle AB, equal segments AC, BD, semicircles on AC, CD, DB, and circle FG).
